name: Huéscar (Spain)
description: White field within a light green border, charged at the centre with the full achievement of the arms of Huéscar (an oval shield on blue with crossed flags and a wreath, inscribed MUY NOBLE Y LEAL CIUDAD DE HUÉSCAR).
history: Huéscar adopted its arms and flag officially on 1 August 2017; the arms are a version of those approved by the council at the end of 1887, first recorded on 2 January 1888. The flag is a rectangular cloth one and a half times longer than wide, white surrounded along its whole perimeter by a bordure.
